title: kTimesG: Phy Challenge

prize.note: one native SegWit address, funded in one transaction on 2026-06-21; the address is recovered from the author's BIP-137 signature and the author confirmed it on 2026-08-13

target_format: one secp256k1 private key (64 hex characters) whose compressed public key hashes to the escrow P2WPKH address; the public key 02425afdd1716149faf414b6fdb96d5e7afc8ce42496042f4df559c80a7c6650eb is recovered from the published signature

derivation.summary: derive the compressed public key of a candidate private key, hash it with SHA-256 and RIPEMD-160, encode as a bech32 P2WPKH address and compare to the escrow; separately, recover the public key from the published BIP-137 signature over the first-post message
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP-173 vector (private key 1 gives bc1qw508d6qejxtdg4y5r3zarvary0c5xw7kv8f3t4) and the recovery of the escrow address from the author's own signature over the author's own message

difficulty_note: the author states the first post holds everything needed and that the solution is quick once seen; the mechanism that turns the signature and the image into a private key has not been published or reproduced

leads.title: read the author's hints as one set
check the structure a forum user reported on 2026-07-29
ask the author a narrow question in the thread
bounded interval search once an interval is derived

sources.title: kTimesG, Phy Challenge, bitcointalk thread (94 posts read)

third_party_material: the signed message and the image are the author's own published puzzle material; short author quotes are in clues/author-posts.md; no other third-party material is included
